source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 10 (PDF 218-233), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Human Respiratory System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is external respiration? What does it involve?
(External respiration kya hai? Is mein kya shamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: External respiration body system ki satah par mahol se oxygen lena aur carbon dioxide mahol mein nikalna hai. Is mein saans lena aur capillaries mein oxygen aur carbon dioxide ka tabadla shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: It involves breathing and the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the capillaries

blocks.prompt:
2 How do our cells finally obtain oxygen from the air?
(Hamare cells hawa se aakhir kar oxygen kaise hasil karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saans se lungs hawa se bharte hain. Oxygen lungs ki geeli membranes se diffuse ho kar khoon mein jati hai aur cells khoon se oxygen lete hain.

book_ref.quote: Oxygen diffuses across the wet membranes of the lungs

blocks.prompt:
3 Why must the respiratory surface be moist and permeable and have a blood supply?
(Respiratory surface ka geela, permeable aur khoon wala hona kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Geela aur permeable (guzarne dene wala): taa ke gases is se guzar sakein.
2. Khoon ki supply: taa ke gases khoon mein aa ja sakein.

book_ref.quote: It is moist and permeable – so that gases may pass through it

blocks.prompt:
4 What is meant by 'air ventilates over the respiratory surface'?
('Hawa respiratory surface par ventilate hoti hai' se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka matlab hai ke hawa respiratory surface ki taraf aati aur us se door jati hai, yani taaza hawa gas tabadle ke liye pahunchti rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: Air ventilates over it i.e., moves towards and away from it

blocks.prompt:
5 Write any three functions of the organs of the upper respiratory tract.
(Upper respiratory tract ke organs ke koi teen kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hawa ko jism mein lana aur nikalna.
2. Aane wali hawa ko saaf karna.
3. Aane wali hawa ko nam aur garam karna.
(In organs mein gas tabadla nahi hota.)

book_ref.quote: These organs are involved in the movement of air into and out of the body

blocks.prompt:
6 How is inhaled air warmed and humidified in the nasal cavity?
(Nasal cavity mein saans ki hawa kaise garam aur nam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab saans ki hawa nasal cavity se guzarti hai to cavity ki satah ke bilkul qareeb khoon ki naliyan use garam aur nam karti hain.

book_ref.quote: it is warmed and humidified by blood vessels present very close to its surface

blocks.prompt:
7 Why is the pharynx called a part of both respiratory and digestive systems?
(Pharynx ko respiratory aur digestive dono systems ka hissa kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pharynx aik nali hai jo nasal aur oral cavities ko larynx aur oesophagus se jorti hai. Hawa nasal cavity se larynx tak (aur wapas) aur khurak munh se oesophagus tak isi se guzarti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, it is part of both the respiratory and the digestive systems

blocks.prompt:
8 How is sound produced in the larynx?
(Larynx mein awaz kaise paida hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Larynx mein do bands, vocal cords, hain. Larynx ke muscles inhein qareeb late hain aur hawa guzarne par yeh thartharate aur awaz banate hain. Yahi muscles awaz ki pitch aur volume bhi control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The vocal cords vibrate when air flows over them and so produce sound

blocks.prompt:
9 What is the role of epiglottis during swallowing?
(Nigalte waqt epiglottis ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nigalte waqt zuban ki peechhe ki harkat larynx ko oopar uthati hai aur epiglottis (cartilage ka dhakkan) neeche ho kar glottis band kar deti hai. Is se nigla hua maadda larynx mein nahi jata.

book_ref.quote: When we swallow something, the backward motion of the tongue raises the larynx

blocks.prompt:
10 What happens if swallowed material starts to enter the larynx?
(Agar nigla hua maadda larynx mein jane lage to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh larynx ko chherta hai aur taqatwar khansi ka reflex shuru hota hai jo aam tor par maadde ko larynx se nikal kar gale mein bhej deta hai.

book_ref.quote: This generally expels the material out of the larynx, and into the throat

blocks.prompt:
11 Why is the lower respiratory tract called tree-like? Where does gas exchange occur in it?
(Lower respiratory tract ko darakht numa kyun kehte hain? Is mein gas tabadla kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trachea aur lower tract ke doosre raste baar baar shakhon mein bant-te hain aur darakht ki shakal banate hain (taqreeban 2,414 km raste). Hawa aur khoon ka gas tabadla sirf lungs mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: These passages make a tree-like shape, with repeated branching

blocks.prompt:
12 How does the trachea keep foreign particles away from the lungs?
(Trachea bahar ke zarraat ko lungs se door kaise rakhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trachea ke andar mucus aur cilia hain. Bahar ke zarraat mucus mein phans jate hain aur cilia unhein pharynx ki taraf dhakel dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The trachea is lined with mucus and cilia

blocks.prompt:
13 Write the sequence of branching from a primary bronchus to the alveoli.
(Primary bronchus se alveoli tak shakhon ki tarteeb likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Primary bronchus → secondary bronchi → tertiary bronchi → bronchioles → terminal bronchioles → alveolar ducts → alveoli ke guchhe

book_ref.quote: The secondary bronchi branch into still smaller tertiary bronchi

blocks.prompt:
14 Differentiate between visceral pleura and parietal pleura.
(Visceral pleura aur parietal pleura mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono har lung ko dhaanpne wali membranes hain jin ke darmiyan fluid bhari pleural cavity hai.

book_ref.quote: the second membrane, parietal pleura, lines the inner wall of thoracic cavity

rows: Pehli (andar wali) membrane
Doosri (bahar wali) membrane
Lungs par hoti hai
Thoracic cavity ki andaruni deewar par hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
15 Compare the right and left lungs.
(Daayen aur baayen lung ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Daayan lung bara aur teen lobes wala; baayan chhota aur do lobes wala hai.

book_ref.quote: Each lung is divided into lobes

rows: Bara
Chhota, dil ke liye jagah chhorta hai
Teen lobes
Do lobes
Teen secondary bronchi
Do secondary bronchi

blocks.prompt:
16 What is surfactant? Write its function.
(Surfactant kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Surfactant alveoli ke kuch epithelial cells ka nikala hua maaye hai jo alveoli ke andar hota hai. Yeh hawa nikalne par alveoli ko pichakne aur chipakne se rokta hai. Sehatmand lungs mein yeh musalsal banta aur jazb hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In healthy lungs, surfactant is constantly secreted and reabsorbed

blocks.prompt:
17 Why do the lungs receive oxygenated blood from the heart, though they themselves oxygenate the blood?
(Lungs khud khoon ko oxygen dete hain, phir bhi unhein dil se oxygen wala khoon kyun milta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary arteries oxygen ke baghair khoon lungs mein oxygen lene ke liye lati hain aur pulmonary veins use dil ko lauta deti hain. Alag se lungs ko dil se oxygen wala khoon milta hai taa ke lungs ke apne cells cellular respiration ke liye oxygen lein.

book_ref.quote: The lungs also receive oxygenated blood from the heart that provides oxygen to the cells of the lungs

blocks.prompt:
18 Name the two sets of muscles that bring about breathing.
(Saans lene ka amal karne wale muscles ke do sets ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Diaphragm: gumbad numa bara skeletal muscle jo thoracic cavity aur pait ko alag karta hai.
2. Intercostal muscles: har do pasliyon ke darmiyan.

book_ref.quote: dome-like large skeletal muscle that separates thoracic cavity and abdomen

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between inspiration and expiration.
(Inspiration aur expiration mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Inspiration muscles ke sukarne se hawa andar lati hai; expiration muscles ke dheele hone se hawa bahar nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: Taking in of air is called inspiration or inhalation

rows: Hawa andar lena
Lungs se hawa bahar nikalna
Diaphragm aur intercostal muscles sukarte hain
Diaphragm aur intercostal muscles dheele hote hain
Diaphragm neeche aur chapta; pasliyan oopar aur pinjra phailta hai
Diaphragm gumbad numa; pasliyan neeche aur pinjra andar
Thorax ki jagah barhti; lungs ka pressure fazai se kam
Thorax ki jagah kam; lungs ka pressure fazai se zyada

blocks.prompt:
20 How is breathing controlled?
(Saans ko kaise control kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har saans medulla oblongata (brain stem) ke respiratory centre ke neurons shuru karte hain. Yeh diaphragm aur intercostal muscles ko impulses bhejte hain jo sukar kar inspiration karte hain. Jab neurons impulses band karte hain to muscles dheele hote hain aur expiration hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: These neurons send impulses to the diaphragm and intercostal muscles

blocks.prompt:
21 Why do athletes often train at high altitudes before competitions?
(Athletes muqablon se pehle aksar oonchai par training kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oonchai par fazai pressure kam hota hai is liye saans mushkil hoti hai. Jism in halaat mein oxygen behtar lene ke tareeqe apna leta hai jo athletes ke kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: which is why athletes often undertake high altitude training prior to competitions

blocks.prompt:
22 How are birds able to obtain enough oxygen even at high altitudes?
(Parinde oonchai par bhi kaafi oxygen kaise hasil kar lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Parindon mein lungs ke saath air sacs bhi hain. Hawa aik rukh mein (bahar → posterior air sacs → lungs → anterior air sacs → bahar) aur khoon ke bahao ke ulat behti hai, is liye gas tabadla bohat behtar hota hai, kam oxygen wali oonchai par bhi.

book_ref.quote: The flow of air is in the opposite direction from blood flow

blocks.prompt:
23 What is meant by gas transport?
(Gas transport se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas transport respiration ka zaroori hissa hai jis mein oxygen lungs se tamam tissues tak aur saath hi carbon dioxide tissues se lungs tak le jayi jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The process known as gas transport is an essential component of respiration

blocks.prompt:
24 Why are vessels with oxygenated blood shown red and those with oxygen-depleted blood shown blue?
(Oxygen wale khoon ki naliyan surkh aur kam oxygen wali neeli kyun dikhayi jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxyhaemoglobin chamakdar surkh hai jab ke deoxyhaemoglobin gehra surkh hai aur tissues ko neelahat deta hai. Isi wajah se oxygen wali naliyan surkh aur kam oxygen wali neeli dikhayi jati hain.

book_ref.quote: vessels that carry oxygenated blood are always shown with a red colour

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between oxyhaemoglobin and deoxyhaemoglobin.
(Oxyhaemoglobin aur deoxyhaemoglobin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Oxyhaemoglobin oxygen se juda haemoglobin hai; deoxyhaemoglobin apni oxygen chhor chuka hai.

book_ref.quote: This molecule has a bright red, tomato juice colour

rows: Oxygen se juda haemoglobin
Oxyhaemoglobin ke oxygen chhorne se banta hai
Chamakdar surkh, tamatar ke ras jaisa
Gehra surkh; tissues ko neelahat deta hai
Lungs mein banta hai (taqreeban 97% haemoglobin)
Tissue capillaries se guzarte waqt banta hai

blocks.prompt:
26 What is the importance of the oxygen reserve in venous blood?
(Venous khoon mein oxygen reserve ki kya ahmiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aaram mein sirf 22% oxyhaemoglobin oxygen deta hai aur 75% reserve rehta hai. Yeh reserve warzish aur aaram dono mein jism ki oxygen zaroorat poori karta hai aur saans ya dil rukne par chaar paanch minute zindagi qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: This large reserve of oxygen enables the blood to fulfil the body’s oxygen needs during exercise

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein reserve 78% likha hai, lekin kitab ke apne adad se 97% − 22% = 75% banta hai. Is liye sahi reserve 75% hai.

blocks.prompt:
27 How does exercise change the unloading of oxygen from haemoglobin?
(Warzish haemoglobin se oxygen utarne ko kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Warzish mein muscles zyada oxygen lete hain, venous PO₂ 20 mm Hg aur saturation 75% se 35% ho jati hai. Arterial khoon ab bhi 97% saturated hai, is liye aaram ke 22% ki bajaye 62% (97% − 35%) oxygen utarti hai.

book_ref.quote: In this case, the percent saturation of haemoglobin drops from 75% to 35%

blocks.prompt:
28 What is Bohr effect?
(Bohr effect kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tissues ki CO₂ khoon ka pH kam karti hai. Kam pH haemoglobin ki oxygen se raghbat kam karta hai aur woh oxygen aasani se chhorta hai. pH ke is asar ko Bohr effect kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: This lowered pH reduces haemoglobin’s affinity for oxygen

blocks.prompt:
29 How does temperature affect oxygen release by haemoglobin?
(Temperature haemoglobin ke oxygen chhorne par kaise asar dalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhna, kam pH ki tarah, haemoglobin ki oxygen se raghbat kam karta hai. Warzish mein skeletal muscles zyada heat banate hain, is liye haemoglobin zyada oxygen chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: During exercise, skeletal muscles produce more heat

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the role of carbonic anhydrase in CO₂ transport?
(CO₂ transport mein carbonic anhydrase ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: RBCs mein carbonic anhydrase CO₂ aur pani ko mila kar carbonic acid (H₂CO₃) banwata hai jo H⁺ aur HCO₃⁻ mein toot-ta hai. H⁺ oxyhaemoglobin se milta hai (jis se oxygen tissue ko milti hai) aur HCO₃⁻ plasma mein chala jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The hydrogen ion readily associates with oxyhaemoglobin and oxygen of oxyhaemoglobin is released to the tissue

blocks.prompt:
31 What is chloride shift?
(Chloride shift kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: RBCs mein bane bicarbonate ions aik transporter ki madad se plasma mein jate hain jo aik bicarbonate ion ke badle aik chloride ion (Cl⁻) deta hai. Is tabadle ko chloride shift ya Hamburger phenomenon kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The movement of bicarbonate ions (HCO₃⁻) is facilitated by a transporter

blocks.prompt:
32 Why is the formation of carbonic acid important for the blood?
(Carbonic acid ka banna khoon ke liye kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh khoon ka acid-base tawazun qaim rakhne mein madad deta hai kyun ke banne wala bicarbonate blood plasma ka sab se bara buffer hai.

book_ref.quote: The formation of carbonic acid is important in maintaining the acid-base balance of the blood

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between carbaminohaemoglobin and carboxyhaemoglobin.
(Carbaminohaemoglobin aur carboxyhaemoglobin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Carbaminohaemoglobin CO₂ le jata hai; carboxyhaemoglobin mein carbon monoxide hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Carboxyhaemoglobin is haemoglobin joined to carbon monoxide (CO)

rows: Haemoglobin ki globin (protein) chains se jurri CO₂
Carbon monoxide (CO) se juda haemoglobin
Taqreeban 20% CO₂ lungs tak le jata hai
Oxygen le jane wala haemoglobin kam kar deta hai
O₂ se muqabla nahi karta jo haem iron se judti hai
CO oxygen se bohat zyada raghbat se judti hai; CO poisoning karti hai

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab CO₂ wale haemoglobin ko 'carboxyhaemoglobin' likhti hai, jo ghalat hai. CO₂ + globin = carbaminohaemoglobin. Carboxyhaemoglobin sirf carbon monoxide (CO) ke saath banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
34 Write any four symptoms of carbon monoxide poisoning.
(Carbon monoxide poisoning ki koi chaar alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sar dard, chakkar, kamzori, matli (saath hi ulajhan, saans phoolna, seene mein dard aur behoshi; sangeen soorat mein dimagh ko mustaqil nuqsan aur maut).

book_ref.quote: Symptoms of CO poisoning may include headache, dizziness, weakness, nausea

blocks.prompt:
35 Why is it dangerous to leave a gas heater burning overnight in a closed room?
(Band kamre mein raat bhar gas heater jalta chhorna khatarnak kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fuel ke adhoore jalne se CO banti hai jo band kamre mein jama ho jati hai. Saans se andar ja kar CO haemoglobin se oxygen ke muqable mein bohat mazbooti se judti hai, oxygen le jane wala haemoglobin kam ho jata hai; is se tissue hypoxia (oxygen ki kami) aur CO poisoning hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: If gas heaters are left burning overnight in closed environments, CO accumulates in the room

blocks.prompt:
36 What are respiratory pigments? Name two of them.
(Respiratory pigments kya hain? Do ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Respiratory pigments khoon ya tissues ke khaas proteins hain jo jism mein oxygen le jate hain. Yeh O₂ jama bhi karte aur CO₂ aur doosri cheezein bhi le jate hain. Misalein: haemoglobin aur myoglobin.

book_ref.quote: They also serve other purposes e.g., O₂ storage, CO₂ transport

blocks.prompt:
37 Why can one haemoglobin molecule carry up to four O₂ molecules?
(Aik haemoglobin molecule chaar O₂ molecules tak kyun le ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haemoglobin ki chaar polypeptide chains hain aur har aik ke pocket mein aik haem group hai, yani chaar haem. Har haem ka iron ion zyada oxygen pressure par aik O₂ pakarta hai; is liye aik molecule chaar O₂ tak le jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In this way, one haemoglobin molecule can carry up to four O₂ molecules

blocks.prompt:
38 What is a haem group? How is it attached to globin?
(Haem group kya hai? Yeh globin se kaise juda hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haem group porphyrin ring mein phansa iron ion hai jise ring ke chaar nitrogen atoms pakarte hain. Har globin polypeptide chain mur kar aik pocket banati hai jis mein haem group judta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each polypeptide chain is folded in such a way that it contains a pocket where the heme group binds

blocks.prompt:
39 Write the structure and function of myoglobin briefly.
(Myoglobin ki banawat aur kaam mukhtasar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: aik monomer jis ki aik polypeptide chain 153 amino acids ki aur aik haem group hai, is liye yeh aik O₂ pakarta hai.
Kaam: skeletal aur cardiac muscle mein; zyada raghbat ki wajah se oxygen jama karta aur muscles ki zaroorat par PO₂ 20 mm Hg se kam par chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: Myoglobin is the oxygen-binding protein in skeletal and cardiac muscle cells of vertebrates

blocks.prompt:
40 Name the upper and lower respiratory tract infections discussed in the chapter.
(Chapter mein bayan ki gayi upper aur lower respiratory tract infections ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Upper respiratory tract infections: sinusitis aur otitis media.
Lower respiratory tract infections: pneumonia, pulmonary tuberculosis, lung abscess aur bronchitis.

book_ref.quote: These respiratory disorders can range from mild and self-limiting conditions

blocks.prompt:
41 Differentiate between acute and chronic sinusitis.
(Acute aur chronic sinusitis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq sinus ki parat ki soojan ke arse mein hai.

book_ref.quote: It may be acute (lasts for 7 to 10 days)

rows: 7 se 10 din rehta hai
12 hafton se zyada rehta hai
Sinus ki parat ki kam arse ki soojan
Lambe arse ki; chronic ya baar baar hone par naak ki surgery ho sakti hai

blocks.prompt:
42 Write any four symptoms of sinusitis.
(Sinusitis ki koi chaar alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bukhar, band naak, peep jaisa naak ka paani, soonghne ki hiss khatam hona (saath hi chehre mein dard, naak ke peechhe se gale mein balgham girne ka ehsas, aur sar dard jo jhukne par barh jata hai).

book_ref.quote: a feeling that phlegm is falling from the back of nose into throat

blocks.prompt:
43 What is otitis media? How is it treated?
(Otitis media kya hai? Is ka ilaj kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Otitis media darmiyani kaan ki soojan hai; yeh acute (achanak) ya chronic (chhe hafton se zyada) ho sakti hai. Ilaj: munh se aur lagane wali dard ki dawaiyan, aur bacteria se ho to antibiotics.

book_ref.quote: Otitis may be acute (rapid onset) or chronic (lasts more than six weeks)

blocks.prompt:
44 What happens to the lungs in pneumonia?
(Pneumonia mein lungs ko kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pneumonia aik acute respiratory infection hai jis mein aik ya dono lungs ke alveoli soojh kar peep aur fluid se bhar jate hain. Is se saans dardnaak aur oxygen ka lena kam ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It makes breathing painful and limits oxygen intake

blocks.prompt:
45 Write any four symptoms of pneumonia.
(Pneumonia ki koi chaar alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Balgham wali khansi, saans phoolna, seene mein dard, bukhar (saath hi jild ka neela parna, bhook na lagna, dil ki tez dhadkan aur thakan).

book_ref.quote: Symptoms: Its symptoms include cough with phlegm, shortness of breath, chest pain

blocks.prompt:
46 What is pulmonary tuberculosis? How does it spread?
(Pulmonary tuberculosis kya hai? Yeh kaise phailti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tuberculosis Mycobacterium tuberculosis se hone wali chronic infection hai; lungs ki TB pulmonary tuberculosis hai. Yeh bohat mutaddi (contagious) hai aur khansi ya chheenk se phailti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is highly contagious and spreads through cough or sneezes

blocks.prompt:
47 How does Mycobacterium damage the lungs in tuberculosis?
(Tuberculosis mein Mycobacterium lungs ko kaise nuqsan pahunchata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria lungs mein ja kar barhte hain aur alveoli samait lung tissue mein soojan aur nuqsan karte hain. Lung tissue mein chhote suraakh ban jate hain aur lungs theek kaam nahi karte; barhi hui halat mein respiratory failure ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The damage to the alveoli can lead to the formation of small cavities or holes in the lung tissue

blocks.prompt:
48 What is COPD? Write its common causes.
(COPD kya hai? Is ki aam wujoohaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) lungs ki chronic soojan wali bimari hai. Aam wujoohaat: tambaku noshi aur nuqsandeh aaloodgi aur chemical fumes ka lamba samna; thora hissa genetic alpha-1 antitrypsin ki kami se.

book_ref.quote: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a chronic inflammatory disease of lungs

blocks.prompt:
49 Name the therapies used for COPD.
(COPD ke liye istemal hone wali therapies ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: COPD la-ilaj hai magar dhuen, aaloodgi aur chemicals se bachao is ki raftar kam karta hai. Therapies: bronchodilators, inhaled corticosteroids, pulmonary rehabilitation aur oxygen therapy; kuch sangeen cases mein lung transplantation.

book_ref.quote: Others therapies include bronchodilators, inhaled corticosteroids, pulmonary rehabilitation, and oxygen therapy

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is breathing difficult in chronic bronchitis?
(Chronic bronchitis mein saans lena mushkil kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chronic bronchitis mein bronchial tubes soojh kar tang ho jati hain. Is se mucus zyada banta hai jo raston ko mazeed band kar ke saans mushkil kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It leads to increased mucus production, which can further block the airways and make breathing difficult

blocks.prompt:
51 Why does emphysema reduce gas exchange?
(Emphysema gas tabadla kyun kam kar deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Emphysema mein alveoli ki andaruni deewarein kharab ho kar aakhir phat jati hain. Bohat si chhoti jagahon ki bajaye aik bari jagah ban jati hai jis se gas tabadle ki satah kam ho jati hai.

book_ref.quote: In emphysema, the inner walls of alveoli are damaged, causing them to eventually rupture
